newsitem.title: USA: JonBenet Ramsey's family moves to Atlanta.
newsitem.headline: JonBenet Ramsey's family moves to Atlanta.

text.p: The parents and brother of slain beauty pageant winner JonBenet Ramsey have moved to Atlanta, their former home and site of the child's grave, a spokeswoman for the family said Thursday.
"John and Patsy and Burke have moved to Atlanta," Rachelle Zimmer said. She said the move took place this week.
The Ramseys lived in the Atlanta area before moving to Colorado in the early 1990s and JonBenet, whose body was found Dec. 26 in the family's Boulder home, was buried in the Atlanta area.
No arrests have been made and no suspects named in the six-month murder investigation.
Zimmer had no details about the Ramsey's new home. Rumours have circulated for months that the family was looking for a home in the Atlanta area.
The family had been spending time in their summer home in Michigan.
The home in Boulder is up for sale, but Zimmer said she had no other details.
John Ramsey, who heads Access Graphics, will spend some time at his company's Boulder office as well as work out of other key offices, a spokeswoman for the company said.
